proof_body:
by
  intro a c z R hs hz
  obtain ⟨r, hzr, hrR⟩ := exists_between hz
  have hr0 : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_lt (norm_nonneg _) hzr
  have hsum : Summable (fun n => ‖a n‖ * r ^ n) := by
    have h := hs (c + (r : ℂ)) (by simpa [abs_of_pos hr0] using hrR)
    have h' := h.norm
    refine h'.congr (fun n => ?_)
    simp [norm_mul, norm_pow, abs_of_pos hr0]
  set F : ℕ → ℂ → ℂ := fun n w => a n * (w - c) ^ n with hF
  have hd : ∀ n, DifferentiableOn ℂ (F n) (Metric.ball c r) := fun n => by
    apply Differentiable.differentiableOn
    simp only [hF]
    fun_prop
  have hle : ∀ n w, w ∈ Metric.ball c r → ‖F n w‖ ≤ ‖a n‖ * r ^ n := by
    intro n w hw
    simp only [hF, norm_mul, norm_pow]
    have : ‖w - c‖ ≤ r := (mem_ball_iff_norm.mp hw).le
    gcongr
  have hzb : z ∈ Metric.ball c r := mem_ball_iff_norm.mpr hzr
  have hsumd := Complex.hasSum_deriv_of_summable_norm hsum hd Metric.isOpen_ball hle hzb
  have hdiff := Complex.differentiableOn_tsum_of_summable_norm hsum hd Metric.isOpen_ball hle
  have e : ∀ n, deriv (F n) z = (n : ℂ) * a n * (z - c) ^ (n - 1) := by
    intro n
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun w : ℂ => (w - c) ^ n) ((n : ℂ) * (z - c) ^ (n - 1) * 1) z := ((hasDerivAt_id z).sub_const c).fun_pow n
    have h2 := h1.const_mul (a n)
    rw [hF]
    simp only
    rw [h2.deriv]
    ring
  simp_rw [e] at hsumd
  exact ⟨_, hsumd, (hdiff.differentiableAt (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hzb)).hasDerivAt⟩
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℂ) (c z : ℂ) (R : ℝ), (∀ w : ℂ, ‖w - c‖ < R → Summable (fun n => a n * (w - c) ^ n)) → ‖z - c‖ < R → ∃ S : ℂ, HasSum (fun n : ℕ => (n : ℂ) * a n * (z - c) ^ (n - 1)) S ∧ HasDerivAt (fun w => ∑' n, a n * (w - c) ^ n) S z
